selection: 15–30 first-authored papers; >=5 early and >=5 late; first 5 versus last 5
boundaries: Original exclusion of same-date sets split by a block boundary retained
binning: 20 equal-count first-block-R bins; mean last-block R and 500 author-bootstrap percentile intervals
correlation: Spearman correlation of individual author block scores, not displayed bin means
bars: Positive R in final block, conditional on positive versus nonpositive first-block R; no bar error bars
next_paper: Strictly earlier 3/5/7 papers; author-equal WLS; author-clustered covariance; field and quarter controls
